comment: The Stone Vigil's second boss's four helpers (BNpcBase 14544, layout 9061123, level 41, 1703 HP): each rides with a whirlwind, using 28731 (a 3-yalm circle round itself, instant) every 0.58 s where the whirlwind is (`director:sweep_bnpc`, content/r1d1_re.lua). 28731 hit the player for 980.5 (the median of its hits) in Bob's Chronofoil capture 1cefedf4 of 2026-11-07 (the Stone Vigil with Duty Support, `questkit chronofoil --battle`). No auto-attack, no timepoints: it acts only as the director says.
